patches.title: Reject duplicate parent-tree keys before vector resizing
patches.description: Backport the upstream guard that prevents stale Parent pointers after repeated keys trigger vector reallocation.

dep3.origin: Manual context port of upstream commit 4ce27cc826bf90cc8dbbd8a8c87bd913cccd7ec0; logic matches upstream, indentation differs in Poppler 0.86.1.

tests.baselineExpectation: The exact installed baseline package exits with Valgrind error code 97 and reports an invalid memory access in StructTreeRoot::parentTreeAdd.
tests.patchedExpectation: The exact installed patched package completes pdfinfo -struct with exit status 0 and Valgrind reports ERROR SUMMARY: 0 errors.

patches.title: Clamp overlong revision 6 PDF passwords before hashing
patches.description: Limit the revision 6 hash input to the PDF-specified 127 bytes so K1 and E remain within their fixed-size buffers.

dep3.origin: Manual minimal backport of upstream commit 60e19a30152560fcccfb2ae7f7559eda560c0160; the upstream patch assumes a newer std::string refactor, so this port clamps the existing GooString length at the revision6Hash buffer boundary.

tests.runner: getpatched/platform:verification/regression.py (Poppler PDFDoc API opening an encrypted R6 PDF under Valgrind Memcheck)
tests.baselineExpectation: The exact installed Debian baseline exits with Valgrind error code 97 and reports an invalid write in libpoppler while PDFDoc opens an encrypted revision 6 PDF with a 180-byte owner password.
tests.patchedExpectation: The exact installed patched Debian package completes the same probe with exit status 0 and Valgrind reports ERROR SUMMARY: 0 errors.
